history.submitter_remarks: Former Chinese name 粉錦路 attested in G.N.2145; replaces description in G.N.2352 of 1972.

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare commencing at its junction with Kam Tin Road and running north north-easterly for approximately 7.8 km to terminate at its junction with Castle Peak Road Kwu Tung and Tai Po Road Fanling as shown coloured red on Drawing No. NTA/YL/14A.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此公路起點自與錦田公路會合處，向東北偏北伸展約七．八公里，至與青山公路古洞段及大埔公路粉嶺段之連接處為止，即 NTA/YL/14A 號圖則塗紅色所示者。
